title: A visit that inspires
audience: IKEA retail leadership: store managers and regional directors
purpose: Persuade leaders to back a three-store, six-month visitation-model pilot

slides.key_message: Reimagine what an IKEA store visit can be.

text.10: A new IKEA store model | 3-store pilot proposal

slides.key_message: The current visit is long and tiring, and too many customers leave without what they came for.

text.0: The list is easy to bring. Finding the thing shouldn't be this hard.
text.20: People visit about three times a year, usually with a list. Visits feel long and tiring. One in three leaves without what they came for. The maze has a purpose—but now it can work against us.

slides.key_message: Customers want to picture life at home and get help making it work.

text.0: People come to picture life at home.
text.13:
They don't just want to be sold furniture. They want to imagine how life could work in their home—and get help making it real.

The best moments are simple: a room setting that sparks an idea. A co-worker who listens and helps.

slides.key_message: Plan, explore, then take home what you need—with the rest delivered.

text.0: A new visit, built around you
text.13:
PLAN
Book a 45-minute home-planning session online before you visit.
text.18:
EXPLORE
Follow a shorter, guided path through five room inspirations matched to your plan.
text.19:
TAKE HOME
Pick up what you need at one point. The rest is delivered.

slides.key_message: Maya turns a first visit into a useful home plan in 90 minutes.

text.0: Maya leaves with a plan—not just a bag.
text.13:
First home. Living-room photos on her phone.
A planner helps her make sense of the space.
Three room settings bring the options to life.
Ninety minutes later, Maya leaves with a plan—and a delivery date.

slides.notes: Maya is the illustrative customer scenario supplied in the brief.

slides.key_message: The pilot aims to make visits shorter while improving commercial and customer outcomes.
slides.notes: All metrics on this slide are illustrative pilot targets, not guaranteed outcomes.

slides.key_message: Test the model in three deliberate phases over six months.

text.15:
MONTH 1  Train co-workers
MONTHS 2–3  Soft launch
MONTHS 4–6  Full pilot and measure

slides.key_message: The pilot needs store-level sponsorship, trained planners, and an in-app booking tool.

text.13:
PEOPLE
Store manager sponsors
12 trained home-planning co-workers per store
text.14:
TOOL
A booking tool in the IKEA app for visitors to reserve a planning session.

slides.key_message: The leadership decision is to back a three-store pilot.
Make visiting IKEA the best part of making a home.

text.20: IKEA the best part of making a home.
